title: Bevel intelligence
description: A charcoal band for an AI coach: three glowing round persona avatars with name pills (the middle one lit under a soft lavender spotlight, the others dimmed), a two-tone title (grey first line, white second), then tall pale cards with a coloured bloom low on the right. On desktop a phone seems pinned in the middle of the window while the cards scroll past, each card revealing its own screen through it, with a small floating image drifting by it; on phones each card holds its phone below the text.
notes: an inverted band (foreground colour behind, background colour text): charcoal under light themes, pale under dark ones; the cards keep the card surface
the pinned phone is CSS sticky inside per-card tracks clipped by each card (no JavaScript); every card must keep the same height
personas, phones and floating images are media slots; empty they are token placeholders
